summary: A bioethicist examines the promises and risks of algorithmic decision-making in healthcare.
description:
As hospitals increasingly rely on predictive algorithms to guide treatment decisions, questions about fairness, transparency, and accountability become harder to avoid. This talk surveys where those questions currently stand.

The speaker draws on several real-world case studies to illustrate both the promise of data-driven diagnosis tools and the ways bias can creep into training data without anyone noticing.

A moderated Q&A follows the talk, and light refreshments are available afterward for anyone who wants to continue the conversation informally.

title: Guest Lecture: The Future of Renewable Energy Storage
summary: An engineer surveys the current landscape of grid-scale battery technology.
